jobs.description:
ViaMotive is not a traditional company. As a multi-brand dealer for brands such as Higer, Temsa and EVM, we provide smart solutions for professional passenger transport.
 

With the growing number of electric buses, our workshop is changing too. That's why we're looking for a skilled 
Diagnostic Bus Technician to join our team.
 

At ViaMotive, you will diagnose technical problems on modern buses and work together with your colleagues to get our vehicles safely back on the road. Every day is different and offers new technical challenges.
 

Your job
 

As a Diagnostic Technician, you will find, analyse and solve technical problems on buses.
 

Your tasks include:
 
 

• Diagnosing technical faults using diagnostic equipment. 

• Reading fault codes and electrical diagrams. 

• Solving mechanical, electrical and electronic problems. 

• Carrying out maintenance and repairs. 

• Testing vehicles after repairs. 

• Helping colleagues with more complex technical issues. 

• Learning about new technologies, including electric buses. 

Who are you?
 
 

• You have a degree in Automotive Technology, Electromechanics, or similar experience. 

• You have experience as a diagnostic technician, bus technician or truck technician. 

• You have a good knowledge of mechanics, electricity and electronics. 

• You have experience using diagnostic tools. 

• You have a category B driving licence (category D is a plus). 

• You can communicate in English or Dutch. 

• You work accurately, care about quality and enjoy working in a team.  

Experience with electric vehicles or an HEV2 certificate is an advantage, but not required. A strong technical mindset and willingness to learn are just as important.
 

Practical
 
 

• Day shift from Monday to Friday. 

• Roadside assistance is mainly during working hours. If you are willing to help outside working hours when needed, this is a plus.

Job description 

Are you an experienced truck driver with a passion for the open road? We're looking for a professional and motivated CE driver to join our team for international and national transport routes.

As a driver, you will be responsible for the safe and timely delivery of palletized goods to our clients, including well-known companies like Hubo and Gamma. Your duties include loading and unloading the truck independently and ensuring deliveries to around five customers per day.

You’ll spend +/- 3 nights per week in your truck, giving you the freedom and independence that come with this role. Your routes will mainly take you through the Benelux, Northern France, and the Ruhr region. You are also responsible for maintaining the black box records and accurately completing CMR documents.

You will work closely with the planning department and always adhere to traffic rules and safety regulations. With your professional and safety-first mindset, you help ensure satisfied customers and a smooth operation.

What We Offer

    
• 
        
International routes with +/- 3 overnight stays per week

    
    
• 
        
Additional 2 days of national transport

    
    
• 
        
A dynamic and independent role within a stable and growing company

    
    
• 
        
Positive work environment with short communication lines

    
    
• 
        
Competitive employment conditions

    

Requirements

    
• 
        
Minimum of 3 years of experience in transport

    
    
• 
        
Able to load/unload independently and open/close the curtain (baché)

    
    
• 
        
Flexible, motivated, and open-minded attitude

    
    
• 
        
EU drivers welcome – must speak good English or German

    
    
• 
        
Strong sense of responsibility regarding safety and compliance

    

Types of Goods Transported

    
• 
        
Aluminum profiles

    
    
• 
        
Automotive parts (e.g. for Honda)

    
    
• 
        
Construction materials

    
    
• 
        
Various general goods

    

Application Process
 Requirements 

    
• You have a CE driving license and code 95.
    
• At least 3 years of experience with a tractor-trailer.
    
• You are customer-friendly and speak good English.
    
• Basic knowledge of French, German, or Dutch is a plus!

As a Van Driver & Logistics Operator, you are the link between our workshop and our customers. You will be responsible for carrying out daily logistics operations across Brussels and throughout Belgium, ensuring that every customer receives a scooter that meets our quality standards.

You will be one of the faces of MUTE on the road and will play a key role in delivering an exceptional customer experience.

Your Responsibilities

Deliveries & Collections

• Deliver electric scooters to customers.
• Collect scooters requiring maintenance or repairs.
• Carry out vehicle swaps when needed.
• Load and unload scooters safely and efficiently.
Logistics Operations

• Optimize routes to maximize operational efficiency.
• Keep the company van clean, organized and in good condition.
• Report any damage or operational issues concerning transported vehicles.
Customer Service

• Represent MUTE professionally during every customer interaction.
• Introduce customers to the basic operation of their scooter upon delivery.
• Answer basic customer questions.
• Ensure every delivery reflects the high service standards of MUTE.
Operational Support

When deliveries are completed, you will support the workshop and logistics team by:

• Moving scooters within the warehouse.
• Preparing vehicles for delivery.
• Cleaning and inspecting scooters.
• Charging and handling batteries safely.
• Assisting the operations team based on daily priorities. 
We are looking for someone who is reliable, proactive and enjoys working independently.

Requirements

• Valid Category B driving licence (mandatory).
• Comfortable driving a delivery van in urban environments.
• Reliable, punctual and well organized.
• Careful with equipment and company vehicles.
• Able to work independently while maintaining high quality standards.
• Physically fit, as the role involves loading and unloading electric scooters.
Preferred Qualifications

• Previous experience in logistics, deliveries or transportation.
• Interest in electric vehicles or sustainable mobility.
• Experience in the mobility, automotive or technical sector is a plus.
• Good knowledge of Brussels and surrounding areas.
Languages

• Good command of English and French.
• Dutch is an advantage but is not required. 
What We Offer

• 6-month full-time contract (38 hours per week), with the possibility of a permanent contract (CDI) based on performance and business needs.
• A dynamic and fast-growing company.
• A young, international and supportive team.
• A varied role with a high level of autonomy.
• Competitive salary based on experience, plus additional benefits.

• 
Support the invoice and purchase order cycle for insurance, maintenance, repairs, and capital expenditures.

• 
Track real estate spending against budget and review invoice allocations and postings.

• 
Assist with reconciliations, monthly closings, accruals, prepaid expenses, capitalization, and depreciation.

• 
Prepare journal entries, fixed asset register updates, and supporting schedules.

• 
Liaise with the Real Estate team and external service providers to resolve questions and follow up on issues.

• 
Support audit preparation, insurance claims management, budget preparation, and ESG reporting.

• 
Help improve procedures, controls, and systems, and support workflow process improvements.

• 
Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or Economics, or equivalent experience.

• 
1 to 2 years of accounting experience, or a recent graduate with relevant internship exposure.

• 
Strong Excel skills; Microsoft Office knowledge is required.

• 
Knowledge of SAP S/4HANA is a plus.

• 
Experience with IFRS, local GAAP, or fixed assets is an asset.

• 
Professional working proficiency in English; another market language is a plus.

• 
Accurate, organized, flexible, and able to work independently and as part of a team.

• 
Process supplier invoices accurately and on time.

• 
Verify, register and prepare invoices for payment.

• 
Investigate and resolve discrepancies between purchase orders and invoices.

• 
Support bank records, reconciliations and payment runs.

• 
Monitor compliance with internal approval procedures.

• 
Handle queries from internal stakeholders and suppliers.

• 
Support month-end closing, audit preparation and archiving.

• 
Contribute to process improvements, controls and projects.

• 
Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance or a related field, or first accounting experience.

• 
Experience in accounts payable or administrative accounting is an asset.

• 
Strong working knowledge of MS Office, especially Excel.

• 
SAP experience is required; SAP S/4HANA is a plus.

• 
Professional English; Dutch or another market language is an advantage.

• 
Accurate, analytical and able to meet deadlines.

• 
Team-oriented, communicative and comfortable with different stakeholders.

• 
Flexible, eager to learn and interested in financial IT systems.

jobs.occupation: warehouse worker / forklift operator - night shift
jobs.description:
Looking for a permanent job on the fixed night shift within an international logistics environment? Then this job might be just the thing for you.

Your responsibilities:

• Loading and unloading containers and trucks with the forklift according to applicable safety procedures.
• Operating the forklift and electric pallet trucks for the efficient internal transport of goods.
• Managing and accurately moving goods within the cold warehouse.
• As a warehouse worker and forklift driver, you work closely with colleagues to ensure the logistics process runs smoothly at night.
You work in a fixed night shift. Start time can be at 16:00 or at 18:30. You choose one of the two for your entire employment.

VG 458/BUOSAP

You hold a forklift certificate, or are willing to take a practical driving test.

You are fluent in Dutch or English (both spoken and written).

You are a great team player.

You prioritize working safely and accurately.

You ensure an optimal flow of goods throughout the entire night shift.

Job description 

Depending on your location, you will start your journey from Genk, Antwerp, or Zeebrugge. You are free to choose your own departure time, provided that you leave before 5:00 a.m. Please note that you must inspect the vehicles for any damage before departure. Ensuring the load is properly secured is a key responsibility!

If you prefer to stay overnight during your routes, this can certainly be discussed.

With the loading list assigned to you, you will have a clear overview of your route and know exactly where to go.

Are you able to provide a highly secure parking location for the truck at your home? Great! If not, you will use your own vehicle to travel to the departure location each time and return the truck in excellent condition after completing your route.

You are able to communicate effectively in Dutch, French, and/or English.

 Requirements 

National routes, with occasional trips across the border to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, or France.

No experience is required; we are looking for passion and motivation for vehicle transport.

A CE driving licence, Code 95 qualification, and a valid medical fitness certificate are required.

Job description 

Your job in a nutshell
 In the evening, when others go to sleep, your workday begins. Between 22h and 00h, you depart with a refrigerated truck towards your first delivery.
 You drive throughout Belgium and deliver to various supermarkets. No stressful city driving, but clear routes and a well-organised schedule.

What will you do?
 • You load and unload using an electric or manual pallet jack
 • You deliver fruits and vegetables to supermarkets across Belgium
 • You check deliveries and documents
 • You drive independently and take responsibility for your own route
 • You ensure correct and safe deliveries

What does your day look like?
 • You start at night at the depot, pick up your truck and depart on your route
 • During your shift you typically make 2 to 6 stops per night and complete your deliveries efficiently. Your workday lasts on average 12 to 15 hours, but you work within a clear and structured system without chaos or unnecessary stress
 • After your round, you return to the depot (Geel) and your workday is finished—and the best part? You simply sleep at home in your own bed

What do we expect from you?
 • CE driving licence with certificates (Code 95 – medical fitness certificate)
 • Good knowledge of English is a must, Lithuanian is a plus
 • You are flexible and customer-oriented
 • You live in the Geel region
 • You perform physical work with a smile
 • Willingness to work weekends (Saturdays and Sundays)

What do you get in return?
 • A very good salary in relation to your effort and hours
 • Many working hours, no hotel nights—always sleeping at home
 • Working with clear structure and fixed routes
 • Permanent contract after a successful temporary employment period

Interested? Apply today and jump on board!

 Requirements 

• CE driving licence with certificates
 • Flexible mindset
 • Good knowledge of English, Russian or Lithuanian
 • Living in the Geel region

Are you a driven team player with a passion for agriculture and technology? As operator potato inbound you are at the base of our production, with challenging tasks in quality, technique and logistics. Will you become our new colleague?

What will you be doing at Agristo?
 
• You will be responsible for the entry control of the quality of the delivered potatoes and for the corresponding administration & registration. 
• You supervise the proper operation of the installation and signal deviations if necessary. 
• You are responsible for cleaning the line and checking various parameters. You can solve first-line disturbances in a professional way, for more complex technical issues you can count on our production technicians.

• You are also responsible for loading all by-products.
 
• You are socially fluent and keen on quality, safety, order & cleanliness, discipline and punctuality.

• You are fluent in a number of current software programs. 
• You are able to drive a forklift truck and terminal truck or are willing to learn to do so. 
• The variety and physical aspect of the job appeals to you. 
• You speak and write Dutch or English fluently.

jobs.occupation: Category CE Driver – variable work, night shift
jobs.description:
Job description 

Transport of mainly sea containers in and around the port of Antwerp or Rotterdam during the night shift.

Occasionally also trailer exchange work with tarpaulin (Bache) to destinations such as Leuven or Liège.

Night work, usually shuttle runs between warehouses and terminals.

Approximately 12 hours per day.

Start between 5 PM and 6 PM, working days between 10 and 15 hours depending on workload and planning.

Good salary, departing from the right bank.

Permanent job with long-term cooperation.

 Requirements 

    
• Driving licence CE + C95

    
• Dutch or English speaking
    
• Night work

For our client in the Veurne region, we are looking for a DIAGNOSIC TECHNICIAN.

The garage not only sells and rents high-quality German vehicles, but also carries out maintenance and repairs to the highest standards.

As a diagnosic technician in the Veurne region, your responsibilities include:

  • Performing vehicle diagnostics;
  • Establishing diagnoses and setting up diagnostic equipment;
  • Carrying out repairs and replacing parts;
  • Working on passenger cars, vans and trucks (depending on experience and skills);
  • Performing maintenance work;
  • Resolving mechanical and electronic issues.
As a diagnosic Technician in the Veurne region, you recognize yourself in the following:

  • You already have a basic knowledge of automotive technology;
  • You are a motivated technician with a passion for technology;
  • You speak Dutch or English.

Job description 

You will be responsible for delivering meat to companies, distribution centers, or supermarkets with a refrigerated trailer.

Possibility of driving shuttles between the customer and distribution centers.

Loading at the processor and 2 to 3 stops per day. Unloading at the dock or using the loading bridge and electric pallet truck.

Working from Monday to Friday.

 

 Requirements 

    
• CE driver's license with a valid C95.
    
• You have initial experience in refrigerated transport.
    
• You are Dutch or speak English well.
    
• Shifts from 10 to 13 hours per day.
    
• Good, open communication with planning/management.

Are you an experienced pipe fitter who has previously worked in a pharmaceutical environment?

We are looking for an experienced pipe fitter for an ongoing project in Geel.

As a company, we are a European player specialising in complex construction projects such as data centres.

Together with your team, you will be responsible for preparing, installing and aligning stainless steel pipes used for sterile/clean processes.

In practical terms, this involves the following tasks:

• Interpreting (3D) plans and diagrams (process flows, pipes, valves, instruments, etc.)

• Installing (hygienic) stainless steel and carbon steel pipes

• Aligning pipes in preparation for the welders

• Fitting brackets, pipe racks, etc.

• Quality checks

• An eye for cleanliness and safety

Naturally, you will always adhere to the applicable procedures regarding working methods and safety.

The working language is English, so you must be proficient in this.

You must already hold a valid VCA certificate and technical competence.

In addition, you have over 5 years’ relevant experience.

Overtime occurs on a weekly basis and is generously paid at 150%.

In addition to an attractive salary in accordance with PC124, you will receive meal vouchers worth €2.59 per day worked.

Will you be joining our team?

Job description 

For a large transport company, you will be working in their distribution center, moving trailers from the parking area to the loading docks and vice versa. You will do this using a Terberg (terminal tractor), a machine specifically designed for this task.

You will communicate via onboard radio with the planning team, who will assign your tasks. For smooth communication, a good knowledge of Dutch or English is required.

There are different shifts: from 04:00 to 14:00, from 05:00 to 17:00, or from 14:00 to 22:00.

A C/CE driving license is required, but Code 95 is not necessary.

 Requirements 

    
• C/CE driving license
    
• Good parking skills with tractor-trailer
    
• Sense of responsibility and focus on safety
    
• Ability to handle stress
    
• Good knowledge of Dutch or English

Are you the passionate technician we're looking for to strengthen our team? Agristo, a market leader in the food industry, is looking for a preventive maintenance technician who is passionate about ensuring the reliability and efficiency of our machines and installations. As a technician, you play a crucial role in ensuring maximum uptime for our machinery.

Are you up to the challenge?

Then this job at Agristo, at our Wielsbeke site, is for you!

What will you be doing at Agristo?
As a maintenance technician, you're passionate about ensuring the reliability and efficiency of our machines and installations. Your objective? To ensure smooth operation and minimise downtime.
 
• Set an example by following the prescribed guidelines and procedures for a (food) safe, environmentally friendly and orderly working environment. 
• As a technician, you recognise potential problems before they cause breakdowns. You report these observations accurately, enabling us to act proactively and minimise unscheduled downtime. 
• You carry out planned maintenance tasks, such as inspections, lubrications, adjustments and replacements. 
• You will work closely with our operational teams and your technical colleagues to optimise the maintenance plan. 
• You will provide the necessary support and follow-up to external collaborators to ensure that their contribution is effective and efficient. In addition, you will mentor technical trainees and new employees to help them progress in their role. 
• You will keep accurate records of maintenance work carried out, using the maintenance software (Ultimo).
 
• You have technical training or equivalent experience. 
• You have several years' experience as a technician and a passion for technology. 
• You have knowledge of mechanical, electrical, hydraulic and pneumatic systems. 
• You have a proactive attitude. 
• You have logical thinking and good problem-solving skills, enabling you to work independently. 
• You are a team player who contributes to smooth communication and collective success. 
• You speak Dutch, French or English and are prepared to understand colleagues who speak other languages. 
• You are prepared to work in a 2-shift system.

Job description 
 Our client specializes in solving logistical challenges that others cannot handle. Whether it’s a large machine part, a box of special screws, or medical equipment, their drivers ensure every delivery is handled carefully and delivered on time. 
For this position, we are looking for a driver with a strong sense of responsibility.
 What does the job involve? 
    
• Daily start times vary between 05:00 and 08:00, with your schedule sent by SMS the evening before
    
• Finishing times are flexible, as new assignments can come in throughout the day
    
• You will drive across the Benelux and occasionally beyond, delivering to hospitals, factories, and companies in cities such as Rotterdam, Amsterdam, and Brussels
    
• You transport one load per trip (dedicated transport): directly from point A to point B
    
• After a delivery in places like Düsseldorf, you may continue through Amsterdam and Antwerp before returning home
    
• Some days involve only national trips, usually shorter routes but following the same dedicated transport principle
    
• You will cover many kilometers while generally being home every weekend
    
• Most assignments are day trips, although overnight stays in the truck are possible by agreement
 Flexibility & work-life balance 
The dispatcher takes your private schedule into account whenever possible with timely communication, but flexibility remains essential for this role.
 Depot location 
Your truck starts and ends each day at the depot in Duffel, so having your own transport to reach the location is required.

 Requirements 

    
• CE driving license + Code 95
    
• Strong sense of responsibility
    
• Independent working attitude
    
• Good knowledge of the European road network
    
• Dutch-speaking or good command of English

Job description 

At this correct company with a family atmosphere, you will drive with clean and well-maintained equipment and primarily do large distribution of pallet goods in the Benelux, France, and Germany.

You will leave early and drive for quite a few hours, but you will still sleep in your own bed every night. You will receive your schedule via the onboard computer (Transics), so you can usually depart from home.

All hours are paid, and in case of any issues, you can always rely on the planning team that will support you. So, if you are a motivated driver with some experience who wants to earn a good income while being home every day, please contact us, and we will ensure you can start quickly!

 Requirements 

    
• License C/CE with the necessary certificates
    
• Good knowledge of the European road network
    
• Physically fit, you load & unload yourself
    
• Experience as a driver and within the sector
    
• Independent, safety, and collegial are some of your keywords
    
• Good knowledge of Dutch/English

Job description 

Earn like an international driver while being home every day!

    
• Collection of waste and press containers with recycled paper
    
• Daily trips within Belgium to companies
    
• Flexible start times between 03:00 and 06:00
    
• Average of 12 working hours per day, with the possibility to work more if desired
    
• 2 to 5 trips per day
    
• Experience with hook lift systems and truck-trailer combinations is a plus, but can be learned on the job
    
• Work from Monday to Friday, with occasional Saturdays in consultation
    
• Hours above 38/week and Saturday hours paid at 150%
    
• Preferably living in the Antwerp, Turnhout, or Hoogstraten region
    
• Permanent contract after a successful interim period
    
• More working hours = higher salary

Interested? Apply now!

 Requirements 

    
• CE driving license
    
• Valid Code 95
    
• Experience is required
    
• Flexible attitude
    
• Dutch-speaking or good command of English
    
• Departure from Merksem
